Definition: Bigthan or Bigthana, a eunuch of Xerxes
BiblicalUsage: Bigthan means in their wine-press, and he is one of the two chamberlains who plotted against the king. In Esther 2:21 Bigthan and Teresh sought to lay hand on King Ahasuerus, and Mordecai told it. In Esther 6:2 the record is read back to the king: it was found written that Mordecai had told of Bigthana and Teresh. The plot failed because a faithful man spoke up.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Bigthan's story is Mordecai's story too: a quiet warning, written down, and remembered on the very night it mattered.
